about_the_game:
Wildwood Down is a charming adventure about a chummy high school senior with Down syndrome who embarks on a deathly humorous adventure along the boardwalk of Wildwood, New Jersey. With his sister's life on the line, Dan must unravel a murder mystery, navigating eccentric characters, and his own unique perspective to crack the case before time runs out. Can this unlikely hero outsmart the danger lurking beneath the cheerful fa-cade of America's favorite seaside destination?

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

​The main character Daniel is voice-acted by our childhood friend / brother from another mother Daniel himself. He has down-syndrome, a fantastic sense of humor, and loves video games. If anyone deserves his own game it's this guy.
​This indie game is a special project for us and we look forward to giving a percentage of the profits to a downs organization when the game is released!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  • 8-10+ hours of Story-Driven Gameplay

  • A Full Cast of Professional Voice Talent

  • Original Soundtrack "Surf Rock Noir" (Live Instruments)

  • Funny Rewarding Puzzles with Minimal "Moon Logic"

  • Full Controller Support (Designed with Steam-Deck in mind)

(Cheeky Puzzles add to the humorous dichotomy of the world of Wildwood Down)

The protagonist Daniel finds himself making donuts, winning an underground wrestling tournament, and getting thrown out of bars in-order to unveil the murderer of his good friend and hopefully save his sister.

(A Fun-tastic Coastal environment with attractive 2D/3D Art)

The visuals are a "first-in-it's-class" for the P&C genre. A combination of 2D pixel and 3D graphics with a unique art style that presents eye popping scenery. Wildwood Down pulls players into it's world: cinematic camera work, a 3d soundscape, full character voice acting, and rich retrograde pixel art.

(An engaging journey with "Daniel" and his eccentric friends)

Provides an immersive adventure with quirky but lovable characters full of jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes. Be ‘Dan,’ and unravel the sinister plot of the "Boardwalk Butcher" and help the high school seniors party on and save your sister!

content_descriptors.notes: Contains occasional cartoon violence and murder victims in certain scenes. Some scenes involve characters drinking alcohol or smoking cigarettes.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 (Dual Core)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible audio device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better (Quad Core) OR Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Pro 560X or Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible audio device

short_description: Step into the hilariously twisted world of Wildwood Down, a side-splitting comedy thriller. Featuring a protagonist with Down Syndrome. (Inspired by and voice acted by the Dev's childhood friend!) Perfect for fans of the P-n-C adventure genre and new comers looking for a wild heartfelt ride!
